### CardDeal

The investment deal card that lists or spotlights a Safqah opportunity: media, qualified badge, status, title, highlights, ROI and term, as a Hero card or a compact Row, across Available, Reserved, Invested and Closed states.

Level: organism · Contains: CardDeal / Media, CardDeal / Headline, CardDeal / Highlights, CardDeal / Metric, StatusPill, Tag, dealTags · Part of: Carousel

Use when:
- Deals feed or home featured deal (Layout=Hero)
- Dense deal lists such as portfolio or closed deals (Layout=Row)
- Showing qualified-only deals to qualified users (Qualified on)

Don't use when:
- Top of a single deal's detail page: use Base card (HeaderCard)
- Updates about a deal or project: use NewsCard or NewsCard / Poster
- Guidance or advisor messages: use CardInfo
- A quick action or CTA nudge: use ActionTile or ActionPrompt

Accessibility: Whole card is one link named by the deal title; status and ROI read as text; Closed state must not rely on dimming alone; never show the qualified badge to standard users.

### CardDeal / Metric

Label plus value line on a deal card, such as ROI 12-29% or Term 6-12 months.

Level: atom · Part of: CardDeal

Use when:

Don't use when:

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

CardDeal surfaces an investment opportunity. The Hero card spotlights a deal (media, exclusivity badge, status, headline, highlights, ROI & term); the compact Row lists deals densely. Both share one set of atoms and a Qualified boolean for qualified-vs-standard users.

### Atomic architecture

Like Select, the organism only arranges named atom instances - no raw shapes. Headline, Metric, Highlights and Media are CardDeal atoms; StatusPill, Tag and the Syntropy arrow are shared atoms; Deal_Tags supplies the qualified badge.

Headline

Metric

Highlights

Media

StatusPill

Tag

Deal_Tags

### Layouts

Hero is the full feature card; Row is a compact list item. Same atoms, two arrangements.

Hero · 358×316

Row · 358×80

### States

Four lifecycle states set the status tone and treatment: Available · Reserved · Invested · Closed (dimmed).

Available

Reserved

Invested

Closed

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Every variant ships LTR and RTL: mirrored layout, right-aligned, Arabic content, left-pointing arrow.

Hero · LTR

Hero · RTL

### Properties

Configure the card with component properties - like Select’s Show Label / Show Icon.

- Qualified - show the exclusive Deal_Tags badge (qualified users) or hide it (standard users).
- Show media · status · highlights · ROI · arrow - toggle each part on or off.
- Media image - swap the Hero image (instance-swap).
- Title, ROI label/value and highlights are editable via the nested atom text properties.

### Code examples

Flutter usage of the deal card and its key properties.

### Hero card

```dart
SafqahCardDeal(
  layout: CardDealLayout.hero,
  state: DealState.available,
  qualified: true,
  title: 'Yamamah Tower',
  roi: '12 – 29%',
  term: '6 – 12 months',
  image: NetworkImage(deal.coverUrl),
)
```

### Compact row

```dart
SafqahCardDeal(
  layout: CardDealLayout.row,
  state: DealState.invested,
  title: deal.name,
  roi: deal.roiRange,
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

When to reach for each layout and how to handle qualification.

Do

Use Hero to spotlight a featured deal - full media, headline, ROI and term.

Don’t

Don’t show the qualified badge to standard users - switch the Qualified boolean off for non-qualified accounts.

Do

Mirror to RTL with Arabic content (the arrow flips to ←) for Arabic locales.

Don’t

Don’t stack Hero cards in long lists - use the compact Row layout instead.
